head_coach.name: Luis de la Fuente
head_coach.play_style_summary: Luis de la Fuente's tactics merge Spain's traditional possession and positional play (Juego de Posición) with increased verticality and directness. He utilizes short-passing triangles and tempo control to pull opponents out of position before quickly releasing explosive wingers into space. Defensively, Spain deploys a high line and intense, man-to-man high-pressing to choke opposition build-ups and win the ball back early.

key_players.name: Lamine Yamal
key_players.performance_stats: Crowned the LaLiga 2025/26 Player of the Season after leading Barcelona to a domestic treble. Across all competitions, he registered 225 completed dribbles (5.47 per 90), 413 touches in the opponent's box (10.05 per 90), and drew 100 fouls, making him Spain's most dangerous attacking outlet.

key_players.name: Pedri
key_players.performance_stats: Upgraded to the world's most valuable midfielder in early 2026. He registered a 7.56 Sofascore rating in LaLiga 2025/26, serving as the core creative architect who dictates transitions, breaks lines, and creates key chances for both club and country.

key_players.name: Pau Cubarsí
key_players.performance_stats: An associative and positional center-back who acts as a structural pillar for a high defensive line. He possesses elite body orientation and spatial scanning, having completed over 2,700 minutes in LaLiga 2025/26 while executing deep playmaking duties with high passing accuracy.
